ordering: stateSeq is monotonic within one page session and includes selection, reference frame, preview and readiness; nullable only for legacy pages
coverage: Only listed snapshot fields are present; absent bodies never means an empty document
send: Freeze the bounded projection with the message and keep the same packet and idempotency key on retry
receipt: Persist the command result independently of an optional stateUpdate; bad optional updates require mirror repair and never replay the command
transport: Direct requires verified exact origin, window, path and channel; otherwise retain authenticated postMessage bridge
subscription: Await explicit subscribed receipt, subscribe before initial projection, ignore prior generations and unsubscribe on exit
permissions: A mirror or a dialogue-only conversation never grants CAD execution; live lease, document identity, revision and scopes remain mandatory
compatibility: Only send cadState or stateUpdate when the broker advertises this protocol; legacy external mode remains supported
